requirement: The AI rewrite always answers: a sample of about ten words for an empty or meaningless box, a rewrite at most ten words longer for meaningful text, the same length on a repeat press, and never more than fifty words

oracle.invariant: 0 failures. 'an empty box gets one sample sentence of about ten words, asked about the question' passes. 'nonsense typed in is told apart by the model and gets a sample, not a rewrite of the nonsense' passes. 'text that means something is rewritten within ten more words and fifty in all' passes. 'a second press with no edit keeps the length of the text, in different words' passes. 'a rewrite is never longer than fifty words, even from a long original' and 'a sample is about ten words; "again" keeps the length of the text it was given' pass.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
